decision.overall_recommendation: VIX gate is open, but this system's own track record is very weak right now (60-sample history: ~1.7% win rate, avg return -2.58%) — that alone argues for materially smaller size and higher selectivity than usual, regardless of how clean any individual setup looks. None of today's candidates are trend_continuation or ema_band_pullback; every setup here is the weaker reversion_bounce bucket (or an unclassified 'null' setup), all against downtrend/transitional TrendState, so treat this as a watchlist of tactical bounce candidates, not high-conviction continuation trades. Three tickers were excluded outright on 'do not touch' fundamental grounds: AFL (three straight EPS misses, declining revenue/income growth, and an extraordinarily heavy 51-sale/0-buy insider pattern), COLD (missed EPS in all 8 trailing quarters, D+ rating, and a stalling long-term trend per TrendEMA200LongSlopePct), and PENN (near-uniform EPS misses including a catastrophic Nov-2025 quarter, plus a negative long-term trend slope diverging from its shorter uptrend read). APG is included but its own technicals (price well below a still-falling EMA20, negative 5-day return) override its KnifeRiskTier tag to still_falling, so it is ranked last and should not be traded. Favor the top few names (PVH, KMT, GMED) where earnings quality, insider activity, and technical confirmation all line up; treat everything below rank ~15 as low-conviction backups only.

ranked_picks.bear_case: targetRevisionMediumPct is -7% and the same 90-day window shows both an insider buy and two insider sales — a mixed signal, not a clean bullish tell; no fresh catalyst is driving the bounce.

ranked_picks.bear_case: Nine insider sales with zero purchases into a stock already carrying 9x days-to-cover short interest reinforces rather than offsets the bear case here, especially with the long-term trend showing signs of stalling rather than genuinely resuming.

sector_capped_out.bear_case: The company has missed EPS estimates in 7 of its last 8 quarters, often by a wide margin — persistent unprofitability despite topline growth is a real risk that the recent contract-win headlines don't fully offset.

sector_capped_out.rationale: Overriding KnifeRiskTier ('forming') to 'still_falling': price well below a still-falling EMA20 combined with a sharply negative 5-day return is the explicit 'real still-falling tell' called out in the methodology — this should not be traded despite a decent earnings record.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Price is still declining relative to its own falling EMA20 with fresh negative momentum, and 8 insiders have sold with zero purchases in the last 90 days — a falling knife with insider selling attached, regardless of the underlying earnings quality.
